summary: First iteration: full backend + frontend E2E testing of NVision MVP. 21/21 backend pytest tests passing (auth, cameras, templates, detections, /analyze with real Gemini 3 Flash vision, events, memory Q&A with Claude Sonnet, channels CRUD + webhook/slack real dispatch + whatsapp simulated, deliveries, credits + topup, api-keys, analytics, BYO keys, camera cascade delete, auth guard). Frontend E2E flow complete: landing -> signup -> dashboard -> Cameras (add with demo snapshot) -> Detections (Trespasser template + Run now producing real Gemini result modal 'NO MATCH · CONF 98% · A daytime view of a closed security gate with no people visible.') -> Events + memory Q&A -> Alerts (webhook to postman-echo dispatched with status=sent).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 767 lines — monolithic. Consider splitting into modules (auth, cameras, detections, analyze, channels, credits) for maintainability, but not blocking for MVP.

dispatch_alert stores an alert_deliveries record only on success/error inside try; if httpx times out on Slack path (>=300 check uses r.status_code without try recovery for that branch specifically) it's fine — code catches; verified working.
credits deduction happens BEFORE vision inference; if Gemini fails the credits are still burned. Consider refund-on-failure. Minor UX concern, not blocker.
answer_memory returns literal string 'No events matched your question in memory.' when events list is empty — client displays it as-is. OK for MVP.
Snapshot base64 is stored capped to 250KB in mongo — could bloat DB fast at scale; consider object storage. Post-MVP.
No rate limiting on /api/analyze — heavy AI calls unrestricted; consider basic per-user rate limit.
test_credentials: TEST user was fresh signup per run (email TEST_nvbe_*/TEST_nvfe_* + Testpass123!). Original tester nvision.tester@example.com/Testpass123! also usable.
seed_data_creation: Each test run signs up a fresh TEST_-prefixed user; leaves cameras/detections/events/channels/api-keys/deliveries behind for that user. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py uses postman-echo.com for webhook dispatch tests (httpbin.org gives frequent 503/timeouts — avoid). Real Gemini vision call takes ~3s and works reliably on the pexels gate image. Memory Q&A hits Claude Sonnet 4.6. WhatsApp/SMS/Voice/Email/Teams channels intentionally return status='simulated' — not a bug. Frontend: after clicking 'Run now' a modal appears with data-testid MATCH badge and caption; navigate away requires closing modal first.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only environmental note: httpbin.org is unreliable (503/timeouts) and was replaced with postman-echo.com in the test suite.
